description:
`kan list` filters only by board and column, and agents need to find cards by field, such as everything labeled `needs-decision`.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Filters": `-f key=value` and `-x key=value`, all filters combined, typed matching per field, a missing field never matching, and `--category`. Build one filter implementation that `kan ready` reuses.

After a_2naKFO3Lq, for `--category`.
title: Add field filters to kan list
